nodes.title: Group Name, Version and Nature into one row
nodes.summary: CapabilityFormFields now wraps Name, Version and Nature in one grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 row instead of Nature sitting in its own row beneath a separate Name/Version flex row.

nodes.title: Proof for grouping Name, Version and Nature into one row
nodes.summary: Adds the one structural test criterion 1 needs -- that Name, Version and Nature share one row container a later field (Timeout) sits outside of -- leaving criteria 2-4 to the existing, unmodified capability-detail-screen.spec.ts and capability-detail-screen-save.spec.ts suites that already prove them.
